remaining_scope_limits: Static source review does not establish that Torch execution or cold replay succeeded.
One archived seed per N8/N32/N64; N16 is a separately budgeted small bootstrap, not a matched pretraining comparison.
New classifier task uses synthetic sources, not actual user data or production Hepta network.
Fixed physical parents with ridge readout do not close the full-network training matrix, learned-circuit superiority, or global QVI-optimality claims.
Both feature banks still execute the same population/value computation; this comparison alone cannot establish computational savings from analytic value/risk features.
Population-state equality is tested on final train states; universal trajectory equivalence is inferred from code structure, not an exhaustive empirical result.

reviewed_claims.Bayes_reference: For label sign(A+B), iid Uniform[-1,1], the pre-B Bayes accuracy is 0.75 and post-B reference is 1.0; proxy XOR 0.5 reference does not apply.
reviewed_claims.actual_model: Imports archived SmallHCSN finite-volume probability/signed-mark population kernel, not cells.py proxy.
reviewed_claims.cold_replay: All five population state tensors plus absolute step and ModelConfig are saved and restored in a fresh Python subprocess; logits/features and final state are compared.
reviewed_claims.dtype_contract: extract/replay inputs cast to model input weight dtype; initial_state casts margin to transport dtype.
reviewed_claims.failure_retention: Per-width parent/candidate exceptions and per-candidate test exceptions are kept in result; completed measurements is not scientific or production acceptance.
reviewed_claims.feature_control: Same physical parent and equal 5*N/2 readout feature dimension. tanh replaces only value/risk fields after physical flow; messages and full state are unaffected by that feature-bank switch.
reviewed_claims.new_source_identity: Explicit research N16 whitelist and explicit namespace package addition; no inherited upstream qualification.
reviewed_claims.parent_identity: Archived N8/N32/N64 checkpoint SHA checked against extracted-file manifest before loading; new N16 parent is declared separately.
reviewed_claims.source_isolation: Both run() and replay_child() validate all research source hashes and imported qualification module paths.
reviewed_claims.split_separation: Training source IDs 91000-91003; dev 92000-92001; test 93000-93003. N16 bootstrap and ridge use train labels only.
reviewed_claims.test_opening: All width/bank candidates and hashes are written to GLOBAL_CANDIDATE_FREEZE before task(test) creates test labels.
